Method of Attack: Injection of custom database settings into MySQL configuration files (my.conf)
Privilege escalation flaws used in combination with injection vulnerability
Combos of these flaws allow attacker to take over unpatched MySQL installations
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploit code released by Golunski
Vulnerabilities tracked as CVE-2016-6662, CVE-2016-6663, CVE-2016-6664
